newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March 21-31 IGP-M index rises 0.27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March 21-31 IGP-M index rises 0.27 pct.

text.p: Brazilian inflation between March 21 and March 31 slowed to 0.27 percent from 0.40 percent between February 21 and February 28 as measured by the IGP-M index released by the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV).

The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators. They are the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.19 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.30 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.61 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC 30 percent and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
